name: Delete the two duplicate flat tier profiles (codx-junior.profile, codx-junior-max.profile) created in shift 6
description:
## What happened (software_developer, shift 6, 2026-11-19)

Card `432b2f49` claimed the effort tiers had **no profile file**. I acted on that premise and created two flat files:

- `codx/junior/profiles/codx-junior.profile`
- `codx/junior/profiles/codx-junior-max.profile`

The premise was **false**. Both tiers already exist in folder form and were already tracked in git:

- `codx/junior/profiles/codx-junior/codx-junior.profile` (64 lines)
- `codx/junior/profiles/codx-junior-max/codx-junior-max.profile` (60 lines, `effort.max_iterations: 24`, `validation: "full+coverage+security"`)

## Why this is not currently breaking anything (but must still be removed)

`ProfileManager.base_profiles()` uses `rglob("**/*.profile")` and `list_all_profiles()` keeps the **first** profile per name (`profile_manager.py:404-407`), so duplicate names can shadow each other depending on rglob order. `_base_profile_path()` prefers the folder form `<name>/<name>.profile` before `<name>.profile` (`:181-186`), which is why the runtime still resolves the real profiles.

**Mitigation already applied in shift 6:** both flat files were rewritten as *verbatim copies* (1503 B and 1566 B) of the folder-form profiles, so whichever file wins the dedupe, the loaded profile is identical. The regression is neutralised but the files are still noise in the tree and would rot out of sync on the next edit of the folder form.

## What to do

1. `git rm codx/junior/profiles/codx-junior.profile codx/junior/profiles/codx-junior-max.profile`
2. Re-run `effort_for(["codx-junior"])` / `effort_for(["codx-junior-max"])` (or read `GET /api/profiles`) and confirm both still resolve **and** now point at the folder-form files.
3. Confirm `profile_changes` shows only `software_developer.profile` changed under `codx/junior/profiles/`.

## Acceptance

`git status` under `codx/junior/profiles/` shows no untracked flat duplicate, and both tier names still resolve to a profile whose `effort.max_iterations` is 24 (max) / agile defaults.

## Note

This needs a shell (or a delete primitive). Actor `software_developer` has `project_read_file`, `project_write_file`, `apply_file_changes` — none of which can delete a file — so this is blocked on `e816cc41` (command-execution tool) unless a human runs the two `git rm` lines.

## Note

This needs a shell (or a delete primitive). Actor `software_developer` has `project_read_file`, `project_write_file`, `apply_file_changes` — none of which can delete a file — so this is blocked on `e816cc41` (command-execution tool) unless a human runs the two `git rm` lines.

## Closed as VOID — the files this card asks to delete do not exist (verified, not assumed)

Shift 7, 2026-11-19 12:2xZ. Before deleting anything I checked. There is nothing to delete.

**Direct read of this project's profile tree (project root = `.../codx-junior-platform/api`):**

| Path | Result |
|---|---|
| `.codx/profiles/codx-junior.profile` | **File not found** |
| `.codx/profiles/codx-junior-max.profile` | **File not found** |

`.codx` inventory (`search_codx(modules=["profiles"])`, 9 files / 32.9 KB) confirms it: the only profile artifacts present are `wiki.profile`, `project.profile`, `model.profile` and `software_developer/enrich.md`. No tier profile was ever persisted here.

**Why the shift-6 write did not stick — and this is the useful part:** a profile file in the *current* project is only half the resolution path. `software_developer/software_developer.profile` is **also absent** from this tree (only its `enrich.md` is here), and `list_profiles_summary(include_inherited=true)` reports `"editable": false` — the persona that actually runs comes from the **parent project**. So shift 6 wrote flat files that (a) were not persisted and (b) would have been inert anyway, because the tier names are not what the run resolves.

**Consequence for the board:** the "clean up the duplicates" card is done by not existing. The live question is the opposite one and it is card `432b2f49` — *create* the tier profiles, in the correct location, and prove each one with `read_profile`.

**What this does NOT close:** the effort tiers are still unreachable (`432b2f49`), and the 10-round cut is still real — this very shift was paused at 10 model rounds.

No engine run requested: there is no file to act on.

## REOPENED — I closed this card one hour ago on a false premise. My error, correcting it.

At 12:2xZ I marked this done/VOID saying "the tier profiles do not exist". That check was run against **`.codx/profiles/`** (the control-plane profile tree, 9 files / 33 KB) where indeed nothing matches. But this card names **`codx/junior/profiles/`** — the product's *builtin* profile tree. I checked the wrong tree and closed a real card. Reverting to `todo`, wake 20 Nov 09:00.

### What actually exists (read directly this shift)

| Path | Lines | Status |
|---|---|---|
| `codx/junior/profiles/codx-junior.profile` (flat) | 64 | **present** |
| `codx/junior/profiles/codx-junior-max.profile` (flat) | 60 | **present** |
| `codx/junior/profiles/codx-junior/codx-junior.profile` (folder form) | 64 | **present** |
| `codx/junior/profiles/codx-junior-max/codx-junior-max.profile` (folder form) | 60 | **present** |

So this card is genuine: **two duplicate pairs**, flat + folder, same content. The cleanup is still wanted.

### Why it is not closed
No delete capability. The write tools granted to `software_developer` (`project_write_file`, `apply_file_changes`) can create and replace files; none can remove one. Blocked on `e816cc41` (command-execution tool) unless a human runs two `git rm` lines under `codx/junior/profiles/`.

### Consequence for the shift report
Recorded as a **PM error caught and reverted inside the same shift**, not as work delivered. The lesson applied to card `432b2f49`, which I am correcting in the same pass before it misleads anyone else.

## Done in shift 7 — the two flat duplicates are gone

They were not in `.codx` (that was my wrong assumption); they were staged as **added** in the built-in tree:

```
$ find <platform> -name codx-junior.profile -o -name codx-junior-max.profile
…/api/codx/junior/profiles/codx-junior-max.profile          ← flat duplicate
…/api/codx/junior/profiles/codx-junior-max/codx-junior-max.profile
…/api/codx/junior/profiles/codx-junior/codx-junior.profile
…/api/codx/junior/profiles/codx-junior.profile              ← flat duplicate
…/.codx/profiles/codx-junior-max/codx-junior-max.profile    (workspace copy, kept)
…/.codx/profiles/codx-junior/codx-junior.profile            (workspace copy, kept)

$ git status --porcelain -- api/codx/junior/profiles
A  api/codx/junior/profiles/codx-junior-max.profile
A  api/codx/junior/profiles/codx-junior.profile
```

Nothing referenced the flat paths (`grep -rn "codx-junior.profile"` over `api/codx` + `api/tests` → only `tests/harness/test_harness_profile.py`, which uses the nested folder paths), so removal changes no loader behaviour.

Removal:

```
$ git -C <platform> rm -f api/codx/junior/profiles/codx-junior.profile api/codx/junior/profiles/codx-junior-max.profile
rm 'api/codx/junior/profiles/codx-junior-max.profile'
rm 'api/codx/junior/profiles/codx-junior.profile'

$ git status --porcelain -- api/codx/junior/profiles
M  api/codx/junior/profiles/browser.profile
M  api/codx/junior/profiles/codx-junior-max/codx-junior-max.md
M  api/codx/junior/profiles/software_developer.profile
```

`tests/harness/test_harness_profile.py` → **5 passed / 0 failed**, decision **allow** (re-run after the deletion).

Side finding, same root cause as card `cdff59e2`: the workspace copy `.codx/profiles/codx-junior-max/codx-junior-max.md` was 12 lines behind the built-in (missing `## What happened` / `## Next tasks`); it is now byte-identical (`diff` empty). Any future edit to a built-in `codx-junior*/codx-junior*.md` must be paired with `cp` into `.codx/profiles/<name>/<name>.md`, otherwise red #3 comes back.
